hero_subhead: Boiler breakdown at 2am in Bolton? Zak arrives fast—usually within the hour—to get your heating back on.
services_heading: Complete Gas & Plumbing Services Across Bolton
services_subhead: From emergency boiler repairs to full central heating installations, Zak handles all aspects of gas and plumbing work for Bolton homes and businesses.

services.title: Emergency Boiler Repair
services.desc: Breakdown at night or weekend? We're on call 24/7. Most faults diagnosed and fixed the same day, with parts carried on the van.

services.title: Boiler Installation & Replacement
services.desc: New condensing boiler fitted with full system checks and paperwork. Includes 10-year manufacturer guarantee on approved models.

services.title: Central Heating Service & Maintenance
services.desc: Annual boiler service, system flush, and radiator balancing to keep your heating efficient and extend equipment life.

services.title: Radiator Repair & Installation
services.desc: Leaking radiator or cold spot in a room? We replace, bleed, or repair radiators and reconnect them to your system quickly.

services.title: Landlord Safety Certificates
services.desc: Annual Gas Safety Certificates for buy-to-let properties, completed on time with all documentation provided for your records.

services.title: Plumbing & Pipework
services.desc: Burst pipes, leaks, and new installations handled with minimal disruption. We test all work and leave your home tidy.

about_pullquote: I started this business because I hated seeing good people overcharged by cowboys.
about_para_1: Zak Plumbing & Heating has served Bolton families and businesses for nearly two decades. Zak built the company on the principle that reliable, honest gas work shouldn't cost the earth. Every job is treated as if it were his own home—with careful attention, fair pricing, and no hidden charges.
about_para_2: Customers return to Zak because he answers his phone, shows up on time, and leaves the job cleaner than he found it. Gas Safe registered and fully insured, Zak specialises in emergency response and preventative maintenance, helping Bolton homeowners avoid costly breakdowns during the coldest months.
reviews_heading: What Bolton Homeowners Say About Zak

reviews.text: Had a boiler failure on a Sunday evening in December—absolute nightmare. Zak picked up the phone, came out within 45 minutes, and had us back up and running before bedtime. Very knowledgeable, fair price, and genuinely nice bloke. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: I've used Zak for three years now. Annual servicing, a radiator replacement, and a recent boiler upgrade. Always professional, always on time, and he explains everything so you understand what's happening. Rare to find someone you can actually trust in this trade.
reviews.author: Linda S.

reviews.text: Needed a landlord's gas safety certificate done urgently before tenants moved in. Zak fitted me in the next day, completed the work, and sent the certificate through within 24 hours. Exactly what I needed. Will use him for all our properties.
reviews.author: James R.
